3313817305297.sourceDescription:
Product Description

 You will receive three sheets of decorative static clings with separate designs. Multiple styles give you flexible choices to coordinate varied decorative layouts for the holiday.
 Classic Christmas tree and snowflake patterns decorate these decals. Green gold and white tones create a minimalist fashionable look, bringing bright festive charm to your holiday window decor.
 The double sided printed design ensures the lovely motifs can be viewed clearly from indoors and outdoors, greatly boosting the decorative effect of your windows.
 Crafted from reliable PVC electrostatic material. Spraying a little water on glass helps the cling stick tighter. Removal is clean with no leftover marks and you can reuse them many times.
 They work well on glass, mirrors, smooth tiles, cabinets and showcases. Perfect decor for winter holiday events, family get-togethers and birthday parties, and they can serve as bird strike warning markers on windows.

Specifications

 Size: 20 x 30 cm

Package Includes

 3 x Christmas window clings

Please Note

 Static cling relies on smooth surface tension; dusty surfaces will weaken the sticking performance.
 Do not apply the decals on paint that peels easily to avoid surface damage.
【Varied Pattern Window Cling Set】: Inside this package you will find 3 sheets of window clings with distinct designs. The rich selection of styles gives you flexibility to fit countless decorating themes.
【Neutral Toned Xmas Pattern Layout】: You will discover blended Christmas tree and snowflake artwork. The palette focuses on green gold and white with a minimalist fashionable style, adding cheerful festive energy to your holiday window display.
【Dual Side Printed Window Decals】: The printing covers both sides of each cling. People inside and outside the building can view the complete design, making your window decorations far more noticeable.
【Residue Free Static Sticker Setup】: Constructed from reliable PVC static film. Spraying a small amount of water on your window helps secure the cling firmly. It lifts off cleanly and can be reused time after time.
【Versatile Smooth Surface Decor】: Works wonderfully on mirrors, glass, tile, flooring, cabinet surfaces and commercial display windows. Ideal embellishment for Christmas celebrations, winter events, family get-togethers and birthdays.

Product Description


 Premium Material & Flexible StructureThis pre‑lit Christmas garland is made of high‑quality PVC artificial pine branches with frosted snow‑sprayed finish. Built‑in bendable wire frame allows you to twist and shape it freely for
 different layout demands. Lush dense pine needles bring full, realistic festive appearance, durable for repeated holiday use.


 Two Size Options AvailableComes in 2 practical lengths to fit various decoration projects: Vension1: 6FT / 180 cm Christmas garland Vension2:9FT / 274 cm Christmas garlandPre‑decorated out of box, no complicated assembly
 required.(Individually boxed fake pine cones)


 Exquisite Christmas Ornaments & Timed LED LightingDecorated with frosted pine cones and bright red berry clusters for classic winter‑holiday visual effect. Equipped with warm white LED string lights, powered by AA batteries (batteries
 not included). Features 8‑hour timing function, automatically cycles 8‑hours on / 16‑hours off. Cord‑free design supports flexible placement without socket restrictions.


 Wide Application ScenariosFlexible garland fits for indoor and covered‑outdoor decoration. Perfect for stair handrails, fireplace mantels, door frames, porch railings, dining table, window, patio arch, entryway, Christmas party backdrop.
 Great for home festive decor and holiday gift choice.


 Important Notes


 Operated by 3 AA batteries, batteries are not included in package.
 Suitable for indoor and covered outdoor use only. Avoid long‑term exposure to heavy rain and direct strong sunlight to prevent fading and damage.
 Please handle gently when bending to keep pine branches and decorative accessories intact.
【Classic 6FT Pre‑Lit Christmas Garland】
Bring festive warmth to your home with this 6FT Pre‑lit garland. Snow‑dusted greenery, natural pine cones, and bright red berries create a rich, welcoming look that captures the spirit of the season. Perfect for staircases, fireplaces, or doorways, this garland adds a classic holiday glow to any space.
【6H Timer & Battery Power】
This Battery operated garland has warm white LED bulbs powered by 3 AA batteries (not included), allowing placement anywhere—no plugs required. A 6‑hour timer automatically switches the lights on and off for convenient, fuss‑free decoration.
【Indoor & Outdoor Use】
Made from durable, waterproof materials, this LED Christmas garland is safe for indoor or outdoor decorating. Hang it along porches, windows, railings, or entryways without worry about rain, snow, or winter weather.
【More Details】
With abundant snow‑flocked PVC tips, soft pine sprigs, realistic pine cones, and vibrant berry clusters, this artificial pine garland captures the look of a freshly cut holiday garland. The full, layered design provides natural volume, while flexible branches allow you to shape and drape it effortlessly for the perfect festive display.
【Ideal Christmas Gift】
This Pre‑lit artificial Christmas garland is a versatile and festive décor piece, making a thoughtful choice for Christmas gifts for loved ones, holiday hosts, or new homeowners. Perfect for parties or seasonal surprises, it brings charm and warmth as timeless holiday decorations throughout the festive season.
Guarantee - 1 month

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. Colour: Black. Quantity: 12 pack.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, it is perfect for gardens, patios, living rooms and parties. It is powered by a BS IP20 transformer for reliable seasonal lighting. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. At a glance: 1.2m RGB star tree | 118 colour-changing LEDs | 12 cascading strands | star topper | controller and app | sturdy base | BS IP20 transformer | indoor and outdoor use.

APP OR CONTROLLER : Change colours, effects and modes with the included controller or the smartphone app.
STURDY BASE : Keeps the tree stable indoors and out.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Perfect for gardens, patios, living rooms and parties.
